about.title: About Working Days Calculator
about.description: The Working Days Calculator computes the number of business days between two dates, excluding weekends and optionally holidays. Essential for project planning, payroll calculations, and business scheduling. Supports custom holiday calendars and different working week configurations, making it adaptable to various business environments and international working patterns.

howTo.title: How to Use the Working Days Calculator

steps.title: Enter Start Date
steps.description: Select the beginning date for your working days calculation period.

steps.title: Enter End Date
steps.description: Choose the ending date to calculate business days between the two dates.

steps.title: Select Country
steps.description: Choose your country or region to apply the appropriate holiday calendar.

steps.title: Configure Working Week
steps.description: Set which days are considered working days based on your business schedule.

steps.title: View Results
steps.description: See total working days with detailed breakdown of weekends and holidays excluded.

faq.a: The calculator includes major national holidays for supported countries including New Year's Day, Independence Day, Christmas, and other significant holidays. You can also customize the holiday list for your specific business needs.

faq.q: Can I change the working week?
faq.a: Yes, you can configure which days are considered working days, accommodating different business schedules and cultural practices. For example, some businesses work Sunday-Thursday instead of Monday-Friday.
The calculator counts complete working days only. If you need partial day calculations or hour-based calculations, use the date difference calculator or time duration calculator instead.
Yes, the calculator includes holiday calendars for major countries and regions worldwide, with options to add custom holidays for specific business requirements or local observances.
